analyst.summary: Hexaware Technologies is an IT services company that re-listed on the Indian markets in early 2025 after several years under private-equity ownership. The underlying business is financially strong -- healthy returns on capital, no net debt, and margins within its own guided range -- but management has just trimmed its full-year revenue growth guidance, citing delayed deal ramps and pressure in its travel-sector client base. That combination of a fresh guidance cut against a valuation that was not obviously cheap to begin with is the reason for caution here.
